# searchapi

```go
import "github.com/kinorai/omnifeed/internal/transport/searchapi"
```

Package searchapi exposes the web\-search use case over plain HTTP/JSON, so non\-MCP clients \(scripts, RAG pipelines, n8n, ...\) can run the same query → result\-URLs search the \`web\_search\` MCP tool provides — no MCP client required. It is mounted only when a Searcher is configured.

```
POST /search
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Body:    {"query": "...", "limit": 10, "time_range": "week", "language": "en", "site": "reddit.com"}
Resp:    [{"title","url","snippet","engine","published_date"}, ...]
```
